title: An expired or already-consumed authorisation code is refused
asA: operator whose callback presents a code the provider has already invalidated
iWant: the flow to terminate cleanly with a stable-coded error
soThat: no session is issued against a code that no longer proves possession

acceptanceCriteria.description: The mock provider returning `invalid_grant` on an expired code causes the flow to terminate without a session issue.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider is configured to expire a specific code after one second and the callback is dispatched after two seconds (test-injected clock)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the callback reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_FAILED` naming the provider response class as `invalid_grant`; no session cookie is set on the response

acceptanceCriteria.description: A callback that presents a code from a pending-flow already consumed on a prior successful exchange is refused before the token endpoint is called.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful flow has consumed state `s3` and code `c3`
acceptanceCriteria.when: a subsequent callback request is dispatched with `state=s3&code=c3`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_STATE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`; the mock provider's `tokenUrl` records zero new request attempts for this state; no session cookie is set on the response
